title: The rehearsal resolves the candidate reader's packages from the installed checkout
goal: Lifecycle updates can pass the rehearsal
acceptance: Test committed failing first: a reader importing an installed-only package rehearses with no blockers; nothing left behind; installed checkout untouched
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
